chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me, saying: Abd al-Karim ibn Muhammad narrated to us, saying: Sahl ibn Zanjalah al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Ibn Abi Uwais narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from Humaid ibn Qais, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas who said:

The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, said: "O children of Abd al-Muttalib! Indeed, I have asked God for you that He teach the ignorant among you, that He make those of you who stand firm steadfast, that He guide those of you who have gone astray, and that He make you brave, generous, and merciful.

Verily, by God, if a man were to stand praying with his feet aligned between al-Rukn and al-Maqam, and then met God bearing hatred toward you, the People of the House, he would surely enter the Fire."

key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahlul Bayt, the People of the House, the Prophet's household
key_terms.الركن والمقام: Al-Rukn (the Black Stone corner) and al-Maqam (Station of Abraham), holiest spots for prayer
key_terms.بغض: Hatred, enmity toward the Prophet's household
key_terms.بني عبد المطلب: Children of Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's immediate clan (Banu Hashim)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about hatred toward Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressed the children of Abd al-Muttalib, his close clan within the Quraysh tribe, making four supplications for them (knowledge, steadfastness, guidance, and noble virtues), then delivered a solemn warning that hatred of Ahlul Bayt nullifies even the most devoted worship. This was reported through Ibn Abbas, who as the Prophet's cousin witnessed this address firsthand.
word_analysis: those who stand firm among you
